# Vendored libraries

The client loads these files from this folder. It does not use a CDN.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.umd.js` | marked (Markdown parser) | 15.0.12 | MIT, see `LICENSE-marked.md` |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify (HTML sanitizer) | 3.2.6 | Apache 2.0 or MPL 2.0, see `LICENSE-dompurify` |

The files are unchanged copies of the npm package files.
